definition: Net federal award obligations; for loans, original transaction subsidy cost is used and loan face value remains separate. Never sums repeated lifetime award totals. Funding and awarding agency views are separate and must not be added together.
sector_basis: Assistance uses explicit reported FABS business-type codes, never words in their descriptions. H/O/S/T/U/V and legacy 06/20 identify higher education; M/N/12 identify nonprofits. Multiple flags use disclosed precedence: individuals (privacy), higher education, nonprofits, public bodies, private sector. Unmapped codes remain unknown. Contract groups retain reported boolean classifications. These are prime-recipient sectors, not program purpose or ultimate beneficiaries. See recipient-sector-audit.json and the pinned federal code definitions.
topic_basis: Unique official SF133 account-purpose match using award-wide federal-account references. Missing or multi-purpose references remain unallocated; no transaction-level dollar shares are invented. Program-title environmental lens is an overlapping, explicitly rule-based view.

limitations: Award obligations are commitments, not cash disbursements or enacted appropriations.
Archived FY2026 records may be revised in later releases; this is the specified archive vintage, not a live ledger.
Program and recipient names can change; identifiers and source titles are retained.
Recipient sectors and topics describe reported records, not a causal finding about administration decisions.
Award-wide federal-account references may span multiple purposes or years; unresolved allocations are retained separately.
